description: Reviewed scale corrections for source rows that appear to be exported per 1000 kg while labelled per kg. Applied only when the user turns corrections on; corrected values are always labelled. Every indicator of a listed row is divided, because the whole row shares one reference amount. Aluminium and copper are deliberately not listed: dividing their factors by 1000 still gives implausible values, so their real reference amount is unknown and they stay excluded until re-exported from openLCA.

corrections.name: Portland cement (CEM I), CEMBUREAU production mix
corrections.reason: Climate change 903.5 per 'kg' is ~1000x the dataset median; 903.5 / 1000 = 0.90 kg CO2-eq/kg, in line with typical published values for Portland cement (about 0.8-0.95).

corrections.name: Special high grade zinc, primary production
corrections.reason: Climate change 3199.7 per 'kg' is ~1000x the dataset median; 3199.7 / 1000 = 3.2 kg CO2-eq/kg, in line with typical published values for primary zinc (about 3-4).
